action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that the PFS extractor in Binwalk did not properly
sanitize file paths. If a user or automated system were tricked into
extracting a specially crafted PFS file system image, an attacker could
possibly use this issue to write arbitrary files and execute arbitrary
code.
isummary:
Binwalk could be made to run programs as your login if it opened a
specially crafted file.
